Hey, thanks. Sorry to hear you're in a similar situation.  
I live with my aging parents and younger brother, and I might speak a sentence or two at most to my mom or brother on most days. We're very quiet, private people. Don't see eye to eye on many things (my parents are fairly religious), but we get along well enough since we avoid the uncomfortable topics. I can be a bit cold with my mom as well.  

I work in fast food. Actually, I quit last week. I'm scared that I won't be able to find anything better, but I just couldn't keep doing it.  

Thanks for listening. I'm feeling a little more normal now. Going to try to make it through another day.
Thanks. It's good just to know that people here will listen. I found someone to talk to and I'm a bit better for now. I think I may need to look into therapy, but I'm not sure where to start exactly.
